style: 144 BPM. Instrumental energetic 2000s melodic pop punk guitar trio with a funky eighth-note bounce, four-four. Bright overdriven real guitar attack, syncopated palm-muted verse rhythm, enormous open power chords and an instantly memorable picked electric guitar melody taking the lead throughout. Fast acoustic drum backbeat, tight hat, cymbal crashes, natural tom and snare fills between sections, driving electric bass that answers the guitar. Short riff or drum-fill opening, tightly muted groove, explosive guitar hook, a short band stop, melodic lead variation and a final hook return. A decisive live-band final chord with amp decay. Youthful, clear, lean, springy and organic. Electric guitars, picked bass and acoustic drum kit only.
